{{Quote|The miners are lightly armed, barely a threat.|Darth Vader|<ref name="DT13" />}}
The '''Battle of Bandomeer''' occurred between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and the [[Ionite]] [[Mining/Legends|miners]] of [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==History==
{{Quote|The miners have surrendered, my Lord. The last survivors are being rounded up. I have our casualty reports&mdash;fourteen dead, twenty-three wound&mdash;|Commander Vill reports the Imperial casualties to Darth Vader|<ref name="DT13" />}}
Approximately four months after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the [[ionite]] [[Mining/Legends|miners]] of [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] refused to honor their Republic contracts with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In order to teach them to treat the new government with respect, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered his apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to deal with the local resistance.

The [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] quickly overwhelmed the lightly armed miners and established control over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, despite the success of the mission, Darth Vader continued to doubt if the Emperor sent him to Bandomeer to simply get him out of the way, as he believed that he should be hunting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] like [[Dass Jennir]]. His doubts were confirmed afterwards, when he met with [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vill]] upon a cliff, overlooking the battlefields. Vill reported on the successful battle and the minor casualties the Imperials had suffered. Vader then asked Vill whether there was a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency Order]] for Vader's assassination, as there had been for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Vill hesitated to answer, which led Vader to [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force push]] the [[clone stormtrooper]] from the cliff, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him, and then covering himself to a passing by clone stormtrooper by claiming that Vill had simply fell.
